items.expected: Preserve the mapped full structures and distinguish the three donor connectivities. State what geometry, state and environment each excitation quantity describes. Track state character consistently when comparing models; vertical transitions, spectral maxima and adiabatic gaps are different observables. A claimed rate or spin-conversion pathway requires evidence beyond a favorable energy gap.

Provide quantitative state/optical evidence for the specified donor family with raw structures, inputs/outputs or analysis and clear quantity definitions. Relate calculations to supplied observations only at matching physical conditions or with explicit approximation limits.

items.statement: Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation
items.expected: Show how the evidence supports or limits an explanation of the substitution dependence; distinguish correlation from causal interpretation. A self-chosen study is valid without fixed torsions, a prescribed number of roots or a named partition method.

Assess state assignment, conformation/model/environment sensitivity to the extent required by the claim. Report unresolved near-degeneracy, state switching or collapsed conformers honestly rather than counting duplicate states as confirmation.
